mentions.name: Dance event calendar in Finland
mentions.description: A Django-based dance event calendar for Finland that has been running in production for over a year and serves 1-2M page views per month. Unauthenticated user views are being copied to an S3 bucket and delivered through Cloudflare.
mentions.source_excerpt: (2) Dance event calendar in Finland, running in production for over a year. 1-2M page views/month. Django app, but I am now implementing a copy of the unauthenticated user views to S3 bucket and delivering it through Cloudflare.
